subject: Request to extend pilot after connector regression
messages:
From: Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@forgewave.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: ForgeWave Platform <platform@forgewave.io>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Pilot extension request — connector regression blocked onboarding

Hi Sean,

Quick note from our side — during the last two integration runs we hit a regression in the ForgeWave connector that blocked our ingestion pipeline. Our engineers are on it but estimated fix ETA slipped to the end of next week. That means we won't be able to complete the pilot validations by the current end date (Mar 5).

We love the performance numbers and are keen to keep moving, but we need runway: would Redwood consider a 2-week extension to the pilot + some sandbox/top-up credits to cover the extra test cycles while we stabilize the connector?

I've attached the connector-error-log.txt and a short timeline. Let me know what you need from our side.

Thanks,
Kenji
Kenji Saito
Head of Platform Engineering — ForgeWave
kenji.saito@forgewave.io
Attach: connector-error-log.txt (text)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@forgewave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 10:03:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — connector regression blocked onboarding

Kenji — thanks for the heads up and for the log. I'm sorry to hear the regression popped up at the worst possible time.

We can absolutely work through this. Quick plan from our side:
- Tentatively approve a 2-week pilot extension (Mar 6 — Mar 19) while your team stabilizes the connector.
- Provide a sandbox credit top-up equivalent to ~200k tokens of evaluation usage to cover retests.
- If engineering needs extra help, we can schedule a 1-hour troubleshooting session with one of our integration engineers.

Marissa / David — can you confirm the credit amount and draft the official email to Kenji? If legal/finance sign-off is needed we can flag it, but I want to keep momentum.

Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — connector regression blocked onboarding

Hi Kenji —

Thanks for the log. We reviewed with Product and Engineering this morning. We're able to approve the two-week extension and the sandbox credit top-up as a one-time make-good for this pilot. Details:
- Extension window: original end date Mar 5 → new end date Mar 19 (provisioned immediately)
- Credits: 200k token-equivalent sandbox top-up (valid for the pilot window)
- Support: 1 x 60-minute integration session with our integration engineer (please propose 2 preferred slots)

I'll attach a short updated MAP (mutual action plan) with the new dates and milestones. Please confirm and I'll get the official amendment and credit applied.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attach: proposed-pilot-extension-plan.pdf (PDF)

Marissa, Sean —

Finance approves the 200k token-equivalent sandbox credit as a one-off under the customer success goodwill budget. I'll route the credit allocation with billing today; it should reflect in the ForgeWave sandbox within 24 hours of your confirmation.

Marissa — can you send the amendment email to Kenji and attach the MAP you mentioned? Also list two possible slots for the integration session (we suggest Wed 3/9 10:00-11:00 PT and Thu 3/10 14:00-15:00 PT).

Thanks —
